title: ThreatAdaptation
description: The Static's Threat Director adapted its defense to what it suffered (CONTRACTS §6; THREAT-DIRECTOR §4 step 5, C37; NX-156). `UP` when the matching operation launched (escorts appear, air defense is reinforced), `DOWN` when its threat-memory counter has decayed away again. Sector level only: it names no site and updates no facility marker (Q-FOW-17, FOG-OF-WAR FOW-13). HOLD_AT_RISK (NX-412 part 4, ECONOMY EC-9, Q-TD-19) is the one category that names a node (nodes are public, FOW-10): a capture operation was launched on a node of the coalition's running victory hold, always UP, no DOWN. Public view: this INTEL line.

side.description: The side whose Director adapted (only the ENEMY's runs until NX-375).

category.description: CONVOY_ESCORT: escorts for convoys after `convoy_attacks`. IADS_REINFORCED: air defense reinforced after `radar_strikes`. HOLD_AT_RISK: a capture operation (OFFENSIVE, RETAKE) launched on a node of the running victory hold, the sitrep "NULL moves on <node>, the hold is at risk" (Q-TD-19). STAGING: a capture operation started forward staging at a base in the sector (THREAT-DIRECTOR §4a FS-5, NX-416), the sitrep "NULL forces are massing in <sector>", always UP, sector level only (no node_id, FOW-13).

node_id.description: HOLD_AT_RISK: the hold node the operation targets; null for every other category.
